title: Growth delta 1:1 lab notes — Harper / Mateo
content:
Context and intent:
- Quick scratchpad for tomorrow's 1:1 with Mateo (IC: backend infra, L4). Goal: align on near-term priorities, clarify blockers, and surface a concrete stretch project for Q3. Keep this informal — capture thoughts live and convert to action items after the meeting.

Agenda (30 min) — flexible, aim for clarity not completeness:
1) Quick sync (5 min) — mood, energy, single-sentence update on last week
2) Blockers deep-dive (8–10 min) — infra perf regression, CI flakiness, infra ticket backlog
3) Career & growth (8 min) — technical ownership vs leadership path, promotion checklist items
4) Roadmap alignment & tradeoffs (5 min) — prioritization across caching work vs rollout infra
5) Actions and clear next steps (2–3 min)

Notes to self before meeting:
- Mateo has been heads-down on the KV cache improvements (PRs in review). He mentioned the CI flakes on Slack last Friday — check noise level and test failure ratio (ask for examples).
- He was interested in mentoring and owning a cross-team perf initiative last 1:1. Probe whether still motivated and what support he needs.
- Bring up parity of on-call rotation: he's been covering more async pager shifts; ensure we balance load and acknowledge overhead.
- Remind about ENG OKR: reduce tail P99 by 15% — see how his cache work maps to measurable impact.

Specific questions to ask Mateo:
- What is the current blocker on the cache PR? Is it design (algorithm) or infra (ops/CI/sgx)?
- Do you have reproducible steps for the regression? If not, can we carve 2 hours to reproduce + root cause?
- Would owning the cross-team perf project require hiring help or can we scope it to a measurable MVP?
- Are you still interested in mentorship responsibilities? If yes, which mentee(s) and time commitment feels doable?

Quick data to reference (prep):
- Last week deploys: 9/10 green, 1 flaky test in unit-ci, 3 intermittent e2e failures on macOS runner (ticket INF-2142).
- KV-cache PR: diff size ~580 lines, perf numbers claim median latency down 6%, 95th down 9% on local bench. Need production canary perf to validate.
- On-call load: Mateo ~24% higher incident hours last sprint (from pager duty logs).

Draft proposals to surface (be explicit):
- Short-term: allocate a half-day pairing session with SRE to reproduce CI flakes and land hotfix; I will block calendar and join first hour.
- Medium-term: scope cross-team perf project as a 6-week discovery + 6-week implementation. Offer to sponsor a headcount request for a contractor during implementation.
- Growth: propose small leadership stretch: run the perf retro in two weeks and present results at Eng All-Hands. We'll add this to promotion evidence (impact & program ownership).

Risks and tradeoffs to call out:
- If we divert too much focus to perf, feature roadmap (caching UX improvements) will slip — discuss acceptable slippage with product if necessary.
- Contractor cost: needs justification — tie to clear metrics (P99 reduction and cost savings).

Open items for follow-up after 1:1 (convert to action items):
- Action A (Mateo): Post a short runbook in INF-2142 with steps to reproduce the CI flakes; due: 2028-03-24.
- Action B (Harper): Block 4 hours next Tue for pairing with Mateo + SRE; RSVP by EOD today.
- Action C (Mateo + Harper): Draft a 1-page proposal for the 12-week perf project (scope, success metrics, resourcing ask); due: 2028-04-04.
- Action D (Harper): Raise a hiring/contractor ticket and link to proposal if OK; due: 2028-04-06.
- Action E (Mateo): Identify 1 mentee and a 3-month mentoring plan (30-min/weekly); due: 2028-03-28.

How I'll close the loop (manager checklist):
- Confirm the runbook exists and I've reviewed it.
- Join the repro session first hour and escalate any infra quotas if we hit limits.
- Add perf project to our roadmap draft and sync with Product lead (Ava Singh).
- Note promotion evidence items in the next calibration doc: deliverables + leadership initiatives.

Soft signals to watch (non-binary):
- Enthusiasm when talking about cross-team work vs preference for individual contributor deep work.
- Language around stress/fatigue ("overloaded", "distracted") — may trigger bandwidth conversation or time off.
- Willingness to ask for help vs attempting to own everything solo.

Meeting run dynamics (logistics):
- Start with 2–3 small wins to set positive tone.
- Use screen share on cache PR to focus discussion if necessary.
- Keep timer on blockers section to avoid derailing career talk.

Notes I'll write during the 1:1 (live capture template):
- Mood: 
- Top blocker: 
- Root cause hypothesis: 
- Immediate next step: 
- Manager commitments: 
- Mateos commitments: 

Post-meeting: convert the above open items into calendar invites and Asana/Jira tasks. Send a short 1-paragraph recap to Mateo (and CC Ava when roadmap asks are included).

Quick sign-off script (for meeting end) to make commitments explicit:
"Thanks — next steps: you'll post runbook by Friday, I'll block pairing time Tuesday, and we'll aim to have the project one-pager by April 4. If anything changes before then, ping me in Slack and we'll re-triage."

Rough transcript snippets to include in promotion packet (if milestones achieved):
- "Led cross-team perf spike that reduced 95th latency by X% on canary"
- "Organized the perf retro and coordinated three teams to scope and deliver a measurable improvement"

Random scratch ideas (noise, capture):
- Could we run a small canary with geo-fenced traffic to validate cache changes overnight? Need ops approval and rollback plan.
- Pair Mateo with a junior SRE for knowledge transfer — leaves a traceable mentorship artifact.

End of notes. Will refine into a cleaner meeting summary after the 1:1 and push action items to Jira.
